lines.en: Well, don't mind if I do!
No, I wouldn't. And none of it was--
Your idea? Oh, I know, Sweet Freddy.
After all, whose name was on the show?
Your fault! Of course not! I agree!
We actually did discuss it, but apparently it tested poorly.
And isn't it true you had a deep, unrequited love for Carly?
Like when I threw myself in front of a taco truck to save her.
Sounds less like love and more like pity.
Well, if you're gonna go off of how it sounds and looks and is,
And now aren't you back where you started producing iCarly,
doing her bidding, even entering into a fake relationship,
Get Freddy back on our side.
Your Honor, permission to wrap the witness in a warm hug.
Your Honor, I've got a slew of other witnesses,
all who will attest to Carly's horrific ways.
What bad things is he gonna say about us?
Don't look at her, Mr. Gibson.
I called you here because you were witness to the pain and suffering
inflicted by Carly Shea on your brother, Gibby.
Well, Gibby wanted to do those stunts most of the time.
Which means some of the time he didn't want to do them.
Let the record show some of the time he didn't want to do them.
I liked it better when I just said happy birthday.
I call to the stand model Bushwell tenant
and just the cutest little angel you've ever seen.
Tell us why you're here today.
To state that the Shea siblings are evil incarnate.
Carly played mind games with me when she was my tutor.
He locked me in a cage.
He squirted me with suspicious liquid.
And once, he threw a cupcake at me.
You did all that stuff to me!
He brought Chuck here to throw you off your game.
Come here, you little demon elf!
I don't want to stop that!
I'm going to take our land!
I hereby nominate myself to represent myself.
Only if you grab me one of those cupcakes.
I have called up the one person who hates Lubert as much as we do.
I'm going to turn that doorman into a doormat!
Lubert was a horrible menace to everyone in the building.
He turned the bush well into the bush hell.
Thank you for that case-shattering testimony.
Lubert, the witness is all yours.
Oh, she was once mine, wasn't she?
Seeing you almost makes me want to smile again.
But sadly, I was robbed of that ability by one Miss Carly Shea.
Can it, Lube. I'm not falling for it.
You nursed me back to health after Carly's exploding muffin basket attack.
I can still smell your perfume.
But you never forget the scent of your first love.
Mrs. Benson was our last hope.
Your Honor, I no longer want to sue Miss Carly Shea for $1 million.
Thank God, he's dropping the case.
I want the money and ownership of iCarly.
You can't take that from me.
But you can take as much of me as you want, you greedy bastard.
Make sure you like and subscribe.
